text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/issue85-design-sol.md <<'EOF'
# Issue 85 design candidate: native static pages

## Decision

Use native SvelteKit pages for `/` and `/methodology`; reserve the existing data-driven App/PageModel for `/search` and entity pages. Extract its shared shell once. Landing and methodology have no search/detail state and should not acquire fictitious model variants to reuse header/footer markup.

## Exact routing sketch

- `routes/+layout.svelte`: retain font and stylesheet imports; render new `SiteShell.svelte` around `children`. Shell owns `.app-shell`, header, wordmark linking `/`, Parliament context, footer. A universal skip link targets `#main-content`, supplied by each page's main element.
- `routes/+page.server.ts`: root compatibility only. If `url.searchParams.has('q') || url.searchParams.has('strictness')`, `redirect(307, '/search' + url.search + url.hash)`; otherwise return empty data. This preserves explicit blank q and strictness-only old search links as well as nonblank queries. Fragments normally never reach the server; browser behavior needs verification if a fragment compatibility guarantee is required.
- `routes/+page.svelte`: renders `LandingPage.svelte`; supplies title/description through `svelte:head`.
- `routes/methodology/+page.svelte`: renders `MethodologyPage.svelte` and metadata. No loader or API dependency.
- `routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts`: keep search/detail loader; change route parser's search recognition from `/` to `/search` (optionally `/search/` to match detail trailing-slash tolerance). Unknown URLs remain existing invalid-detail behavior.
- `routes/[...path]/+page.svelte`: remains App renderer.
- `App.svelte`: becomes only exhaustive search/detail content selection. Header/footer move, not duplicate.

This deliberately leaves `/search` under the existing catch-all rather than copying its loader to a static search route. Static root and methodology routes outrank the catch-all. If routing ownership is cleaned up later, a dedicated `/search` page can reuse a factored loader then; it is unnecessary for this issue.

## Domain and link invariants

`PageModel` stays exactly search | detail. `DetailRoute` stays current union with search recognized at `/search`; do not add landing/methodology variants to an entity-route parser.

`backToSearch(params)` returns `/search` plus retained q/strictness. Crucial: `memberHref` and `funderHref` currently derive a query suffix with `backToSearch(params).slice(1)`. Changing backToSearch alone corrupts every entity URL (e.g. `/members/123search?q=x`). Introduce a local `searchContextQuery(params): string` returning `''` or `'?q=...&strictness=...'`; have all three builders compose their own path plus this helper. Canonical search routes, entity links, browser back, and tabs then retain the same context without coupling a query to a path length.

SearchPage currently constructs URLs from `page.url`, so navigation naturally stays on `/search` after redirect. Inspect all hard-coded root hrefs in tests and source and classify home links versus search links before changing them. Keep logo `/`. Keep legacy root-query links in explicit compatibility tests rather than replacing every root occurrence mechanically.

## Landing composition

Full viewport-height shell with normal-flow header and footer; center a compact left-aligned content block vertically in remaining space. Black ground, existing Manrope and purple accent, no illustration or extra data fetch. Desktop content width about 760px, sentence width about 17–21 characters at 64–76px fluid type. Sentence: “Explore the interests declared by UK Members of Parliament.” This makes the scope clear without promising comprehensiveness or implying funders are the only data.

A short optional eyebrow “PARLIAMENTARY DECLARATIONS” adds hierarchy only if needed; prefer the sentence and two controls alone to satisfy single-screen brevity. Primary anchor “Search declarations” links `/search`, filled purple with dark text following existing tokens. Secondary “Methodology” links `/methodology`, quiet outline with identical height. Controls are links, not buttons with scripted navigation. Place inline at desktop with 12px gap; stack full-width below roughly 420px. Preserve clear focus styles and minimum 44px target heights.

Use `min-height: 100svh`, flex column shell, content flex:1, and generous responsive padding, not fixed viewport height/hidden overflow. Small screens and zoom may legitimately scroll; footer must remain reachable. Landing uses 38–44px text at narrow widths and 24px gutters. Do not add search input to landing.

## Methodology destination and issue 86

Ship a small useful methodology page now, without pretending the fuller issue 86 is complete. Provide a page heading and three concise grounded sections: source (UK Parliament Register of Members' Financial Interests, linked to official source already established by repo); what records represent (declared interests and recorded entries, with unknown amounts/currencies surfaced as unavailable); interpretation (declarations are records of interests, not findings of wrongdoing; do not equate row counts to amounts). Include “Search declarations” and home links. Verify exact claims against repository/import code before using them; omit unverified update cadence, date coverage, category completeness, normalization, or matching details. No “coming soon” dead end. Issue 86 can later expand this same canonical URL.

## Alternative: PageModel variants

Add `{kind:'landing'}` and `{kind:'methodology'}` to PageModel, extend the catch-all loader and App's branch, keep shell in App. This is a smaller initial markup movement and avoids a cross-page shell extraction. Costs: root editorial pages enter an entity/search loader; route parsing needs an unrelated global-page union or special pathname checks; every switch/skip-link conditional must handle extra kinds; metadata remains centralized or conditional. Good if those pages genuinely need common app data; none do here. Prefer static pages because filesystem routes express the page ownership and missing API cannot break landing/methodology.

## Verification and risks

- Root without query shows landing without API calls; `/search` renders idle search and working interactions.
- `/?q=alice&strictness=2`, `/?q=`, and `/?strictness=2` redirect, retain URL parameters, and have the expected search behavior. Test redirect chain and JS-disabled direct navigation.
- Search → member/funder → history → back to search retains query/strictness and emits no `search` segment inside entity URLs.
- Direct member/funder links and unknown URLs preserve current behavior; `/methodology` is a real SSR page with useful content.
- Verify keyboard skip target, logical heading, focus visibility, reduced viewport, zoom, and footer reachability.
- Existing root-based browser tests need deliberate updates; compatibility tests stay root-based. Capture desktop landing, search, and methodology screenshots from the completed branch for PR attachments. No screenshots in Git.
- Main risk is shell CSS assuming App owns layout or page-specific main IDs. Inspect existing selectors and preserve search/detail geometry during extraction. Keep change focused to routing, shell, and two static content pages.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));

Limit initial copy to a source section naming UK Parliament's Register of Members' Financial Interests, linking the official source already established by the repository, and a licence section reproducing the existing Parliamentary information/Open Parliament Licence attribution. State plainly that a fuller explanation of how the records are processed and presented is being developed, optionally linking the public issue #86 if its URL and title are verified. Include “Search declarations” and home links. Do not assert matching rules, update cadence, date coverage, completeness, or financial interpretation until issue 86 establishes them. This is a useful source and licensing destination today; issue 86 expands this same canonical URL.''' + s[end:];open(p,'w').write(s)

content.text:
Design sketch saved to `/tmp/issue85-design-sol.md`.

Recommends native static root/methodology pages, shared layout shell, `/search` under existing catch-all, legacy query redirects, and extracting the shared query suffix before changing `backToSearch`. Includes responsive design, alternative comparison, and verification risks.
